20 | Detect Ambush True | 10'R/lvl | 10 min/lvl(C) | self | I

50 | Tracks Ahead | 1 mi/lvl | C | 100' | I

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster learns origin and nearest “destination” of the closest path within the
area of effect.
@@ 2
Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section
15.12 (p. 98).
@@ 3
Caster gets a special bonus of +50 for all Tracking maneuvers.
@@ 4
Caster acquires visual image of any user(s) of a given path, up to 1 hour in
the past per level of the caster.
@@ 5
Caster learns the location(s) of any path(s) within 1 mile. This spell reveals
the nearest point on path, but not the path’s course.
@@ 6
Caster learns origin of tracks, and acquires a visual image of the one who
left them. Caster will gain a special bonus of +25 when tracking this
particular being or animal.
@@ 7
Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile
intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the
caster. The being’s hostility must be active (i.e., the being intends to
perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., no action is planned).
@@ 8
Caster acquires visual and aural (sound) image of any being or animal that has
passed within a 50' radius of a specific object. The being or animal can have
passed up to 1 hour per level earlier. If more than one being or animal has
passed, the caster will see them one image at a time, 1 image per round
(starting with the oldest image).
@@ 9
As Pathfinding I, except range is 5 miles.
@@ 10
Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 animal species.
@@ 11
Caster acquires a visual image of all beings or animals who left tracks in the
area. This provides a special bonus of +50 when later tracking that particular
being or animal. If more than one being or animal has left tracks, the caster
will see them one image at a time, one image per round (starting with the
oldest image).
@@ 12
Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 plant species.
@@ 13
As Pathfinding I, except for range.
@@ 14
As Detect Ambush I, except area of effect is 100' radius.
@@ 15
Allows caster to understand and “speak' the language of any 1 “stone”.
@@ 16
As Tracking I, except bonus is +75.
@@ 17
As Detect Ambush I, except area of effect is 150' radius.
@@ 19
As Pathfinding I, except range is 1 mile per level and exact route(s) within
the range are ascertained.
@@ 20
As Detect Ambush, except area of effect is 10' radius per level.
@@ 25
Allows caster to ascertain the proper path to what he seeks (includes the
course along that path). For example, he will always know the best way to
Syclax.
@@ 30
As Tracking, except that it will negate any Hide Tracks spell (except for Hide
Tracks True), and will always give tracker a special +100 Tracking bonus.
@@ 50
Allows caster to know entire course of the tracks in the area of effect (i.e.,
exactly where and how they go). This will not negate Hide Tracks True.
